title: Complete DIRECT method coverage
description: Verify and, where needed, fix direct listener configuration, bind/port conflicts, process lifecycle, cleanup, and actionable errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Direct inputs validate local/remote host and port semantics for the selected nodes
Command/config generation is deterministic and uses resolved binaries safely
Start/stop/restart/reconnect/cleanup tests cover listener ownership and port conflict
A stopped or failed direct tunnel is never reported as running

steps.details: Extend method harness with valid/invalid direct configs, conflict, missing binary, process failure, and cleanup cases.
Read `config/direct.ts`, engine planner, process handles, and current method tests; record concrete gaps.
Apply only evidence-backed command/state fixes and keep the existing public method contract.
Run focused tests, custom harness, typecheck, and lint; record real listener/VPS evidence separately.

technicalNotes: Do not expose raw process command lines in API diagnostics; redact credentials and sensitive endpoints as required by the existing UI contract.
